placement: Capability Pack — src/capabilities/media/ with its own contract unit limen.media. Denied, device unavailable (not found, in use, overconstrained), track and capture ended, cancelled and stale are explicit outcomes or facts; stopping, releasing, cancelling a pending capture and disposing the provider all stop every track.
